Priya: Heads-up: scheduling a focused pen test on billing + webhook ingestion next Wed 09:00-11:00 PT. In-scope: token layer, billing-worker, webhook parser. Exclude live PII stores. Need RBAC window, KMS read-only surface, and an S3 evidence pipeline with manifest checks.

Noah: I can own presigned uploads and ephemeral role. Will NOT allow kms:Decrypt or GenerateDataKey. Presigned prefix = pen-tests/billing/2800001234/ ; TTL=12h. Require content-md5 header and manifest.json with sha256.

Jin: Oncall: available 08:30-11:30 PT. Create a tiny rollback play: remove any test creds + revoke role. Page me if vendor triggers an exploit.

Ivy: Product-sec: freeze deploys 07:00-13:00 PT. Request CloudTrail + app log snapshot exported to security-bucket with SHA256; retention 90 days OK?

Priya: 90 days fine. Ephemeral role via STS with external-id, TTL 2h. Minimal IAM snippet will only allow DescribeKey/ListAliases/GetKeyRotationStatus and S3 PutObject on the evidence prefix. No crypto ops.

Noah: Implementation notes: kms-proxy logs to security-traces bucket. Presigned lambda will validate manifest.json contents and checksum before accepting uploads. We'll enable CloudTrail for KMS & STS data events.

Priya: Vendor onboarding checklist for SEC-PT-4510: NDA+AUP, external-id + role ARN, presigned pattern, manifest schema, oncall contacts. Vendor contact: tests@vendor.example.

evidence-bot: CloudTrail export scheduled 06:15 PT -> security-bucket/exports/2800001234/ ; checksums attached.

Noah: :thumbsup: Presigned lambda + manifest validation deployed to staging.

Jin: :thumbsup: Runbook posted to ticket. I'll be paged first.

Ivy: :thumbsup: Triage doc + retest policy added to SEC-PT-4510.

Priya: Thanks all :closing_paren: tagging follow-ups in the ticket.
